items.title: DALI Lighting Awards 2027 open for entries
items.summary: Entries are open for the 2027 DALI Lighting Awards, recognising projects that demonstrate effective use of DALI-based lighting control systems, with submissions due 8 January 2027.

items.title: ENERGY STAR Transitioning From EPA to DOE
items.summary: Federal oversight of the ENERGY STAR programme is shifting from the EPA to the DOE; fixture and lamp certification categories have already been dropped, leaving only downlight and ceiling fan programmes active, affecting spec compliance references.

items.title: Product Monday: Korrus Ecosense Circadian Lighting Line
items.summary: Korrus has launched a full-range circadian lighting system spanning multiple fixture types, aiming to let specifiers implement consistent tunable lighting across a whole space rather than single isolated products.
